name: Sunmi D3 Pro
title: Sunmi D3 Pro POS System | OnePlusTwo
description: The Sunmi D3 Pro: a sleek, sturdy countertop till with a large touchscreen and an optional customer display, set up and ready for OnePlusTwo.
lead: A sleek, sturdy countertop till with a large touchscreen, built for busy counters. Add a customer-facing second screen so people can check their order as it’s rung through.
images: Sunmi D3 Pro desktop POS with a single screen
Sunmi D3 Pro desktop POS with a customer-facing second screen
features: Available as a complete till kit or the system on its own

faqs: Can I add a customer display to the Sunmi D3 Pro?
Yes. You can add a customer-facing second screen, so customers can check their order as it’s rung through. It’s available in our hardware shop.

Yes. You can order it as a complete till kit with a receipt printer, cash drawer and integrated card machine, or as the system on its own.

name: Sunmi P3 Mix
title: Sunmi P3 Mix Handheld POS | OnePlusTwo
description: The Sunmi P3 Mix: a tablet till with a built-in receipt printer and chip & PIN card reader. Take orders and payments anywhere in your venue.
lead: A tablet till with a built-in receipt printer and a built-in card reader that takes chip & PIN as well as contactless. Add the optional cradle base to use it as a desktop POS.
images: Sunmi P3 Mix tablet POS on its optional cradle base
features: Built-in card reader for chip & PIN and contactless
Take orders and payments on the go
Optional cradle base to use it as a desktop POS
best_for: Restaurants taking orders and payments at the table, and staff who need to serve away from the counter.
faqs: Does the Sunmi P3 Mix take chip & PIN?
Yes. It has a built-in card reader that takes chip & PIN as well as contactless payments.
Can the Sunmi P3 Mix be used as a desktop till?
Yes. Add the optional cradle base to use it as a desktop POS.
What’s the difference between the Sunmi P3 Mix and V3 Mix?

The P3 Mix has a built-in card reader for chip & PIN and contactless. The V3 Mix takes contactless payments with Tap to Pay via NFC, using the tablet itself as the card reader, and is a lower-cost way in.

name: Sunmi P2SE
title: Sunmi P2SE Card Machine | OnePlusTwo
description: The Sunmi P2SE: a compact card machine for chip & PIN and contactless payments that receives the amount straight from your OnePlusTwo till.
lead: The compact card machine we use with our tills. It takes chip & PIN and contactless payments and receives the amount straight from your till, so there’s nothing to type in and fewer mistakes.
features: Receives the amount straight from your till
Fewer keying mistakes at the counter
best_for: Any counter that wants card payments linked to the till, so totals never need typing in.

Yes. It receives the amount straight from your OnePlusTwo till, so there’s nothing to type in.
